source: 《海上指挥》主/次水面战斗舰船（经调整）行94：通信（expanded manual PDF14/15, personally viewed 2026-10-28 and re-viewed 2026-10-29；both ship-size tables print identical group wording）

english_2026_main_rules.printed: 14-9 §14.5 Communications: 1-2 Long-range radio communications / 3-4 Short-range radio communications / 5-6 Aircraft radio communications; loss of long-range comms prevents the ship from communicating with units beyond the horizon; losing short-range communications prevents ships from using radio with other ships in the same formation; aircraft radio is necessary to communicate with any aircraft, whether it is a helicopter or controlling interceptors on-scene, talking to its helicopter or a carrier marshalling aircraft for landing.

authority.english_priority: CaS conversion is the optional E00 self-fit rule; the base English 14-9 §14.5 Communications block carries the same three scopes and is the English authority for the scope wording

producer: existing: expanded_damage2026::resolve_extra "communications" rolls D6 and component_critical disables one fitted ComponentKind::Communications room with the matching cas_group (unchanged this batch; no natural hit re-implemented)

long_range.printed: 远程无线电通信。舰船不能与地平线以外的单位通信。
long_range.printed_en: Loss of long-range comms prevents the ship from communicating with units beyond the horizon.
long_range.scope: applies to any unit endpoint (ships and aircraft alike) only when the link is actually beyond the radio horizon

short_range.printed: 近程无线电通信。舰船不能与同一编队中的其他舰船进行无线电通信。
short_range.printed_en: Losing short-range communications prevents ships from using radio with other ships in the same formation.
short_range.scope: applies only to ship-to-ship links inside the same declared formation; ship/aircraft, ship/submarine and cross-formation links are outside the scope

aircraft.printed: 飞机无线电通信。舰船不能与飞机通信。
aircraft.printed_en: Aircraft radio is necessary to communicate with any aircraft, whether it is a helicopter or controlling interceptors on-scene, talking to its helicopter or a carrier marshalling aircraft for landing.
aircraft.scope: applies to any link with an aircraft endpoint, unconditionally on range or formation

consumer_abi.semantics: All fitted rooms intact or no fitted room => no CaS block; all fitted rooms disabled => group unavailable; partial surviving-room redundancy and component source gaps => pending. No implicit spare-room redundancy (unprinted).
consumer_abi.gate: radio_pair_gate(&World, sender, receiver, beyond_los: Option<bool>, same_formation: Option<bool>): Some(false) scope-inapplicable passes; Some(true) scope-applied blocks with 'radio group unavailable'; None unresolved scope fails closed with '<group> ... source_pending' naming the missing declared input
consumer_abi.helper: group_for_cas_die(d: u8) -> Result<&'static str, String> maps the printed 1-2/3-4/5-6 spans without re-rolling

qualification.type: links::RadioQualification (VoiceFit.radio_qualification: Option<links::RadioQualification>, root-added shared parent field)

fields.source: must be scenario_assumption…; validated in links::validate_config
fields.antenna_height_m: declared feed height for the printed radio horizon; consumed only where the fitted transport prints no antenna height (HF/satellite/author-directed); an HF height is never assumed; LOS transports always use their own printed heights
fields.formation: typed links::FormationId(String); two ships are same-formation only when both endpoints declare the same non-empty id; never inferred from side or peers

qualification.validation: non-authored source, negative/non-finite height, blank formation, or a qualification with neither input is a configuration error at load

link_points_parent_wires.long_range: links::route resolves beyond_los per transport pair and calls radio_pair_gate before the transport match
link_points_parent_wires.short_range: links::route resolves same_formation (ship-ship only) and calls radio_pair_gate
link_points_parent_wires.aircraft: radio_pair_gate checks the aircraft group on both endpoints whenever either endpoint is PlatformKind::Aircraft

consumer_abi.precedent: detection2026/sonobuoys.rs::power consumes binding_operational(ComponentKind::Communications, "sonobuoy_radio") — same style of gate keyed on cas_group
consumer_abi.consumers: communications2026::edges (warnings/solutions/air solutions), validate_transport (GCI vectors, aircombat starting) — all ride links::route
